verdict.rationale: PostHog explicitly documents an MCP server and API supporting agent-driven querying — running trends, funnels, HogQL/SQL queries, and stack trace analysis via Claude or other AI editors — plus an OpenAPI spec and data warehouse SQL across sources, strongly matching the story. However, community evidence shows real friction with the LLM/AI integration (incorrect cohort query handling, severe performance issues in the query builder), so execution quality is disputed in practice.
